verdict.rationale: Bland's voices docs show you can clone your own voice from a clean sample of about ten seconds and set its defaults, which covers the cloning core of the story. The pack has nothing on a documented consent process for cloning, and nothing explicit on assigning the cloned voice to agents. missing for 10: documented consent/verification process for voice cloning, explicit documentation of attaching cloned voices to agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of clone quality

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process

citations.quote: Pick a built-in voice, clone your own, and set its defaults.
A clone needs one clean sample of about ten seconds.
